metadata.title: Kosh CRM
metadata.description: Salon management and financial CRM for Kosh Salon

brand.name: Kosh
brand.panelTitle: Run your salon from one place
brand.panelBody: Invoices, expenses, employee earnings, and monthly settlements, in English and Arabic.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.welcomeBody: Your salon's numbers appear here as invoices and expenses are recorded.

revenueChart.title: Monthly revenue
revenueChart.empty: Revenue appears here once invoices are recorded.

topServices.title: Top services
topServices.empty: Your most requested services appear here once invoices are recorded.

info.title: Personal information
info.description: Update your name and phone number.
info.name: Full name
info.phoneHint: Digits, spaces, and + - ( ) only. Leave empty to remove it.

details.title: Account details
details.description: Only the salon administrator can change these.

errors.generic: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Enter your username or email and password.
login.resetDone: Your password was changed. Sign in with your new password.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Enter your username or email and we will email you a reset link.
forgot.sent: If a matching active account exists, it will receive an email with a reset link within a few minutes. The link is valid for one hour.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.description: Choose a new password for your account. You will be signed out on all devices.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.description: You will be signed out on all other devices.
changePassword.success: Your password was changed. Other devices have been signed out.

errors.inactive: This account is inactive. Contact the salon administrator.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.invalid_token: This reset link is invalid, has expired, or was already used.
errors.unexpected: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

login.subject: New sign-in to Kosh CRM
login.body: Your Kosh CRM account was just signed in to.
login.notYou: If this was not you, reset your password now and tell the salon administrator.

reset.subject: Reset your Kosh CRM password
reset.body: Someone asked to reset the password for your Kosh CRM account. Use the link below to choose a new password.
reset.expiry: The link is valid for one hour and can be used once.
reset.ignore: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email; your password stays the same.
